reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar plugin that retrieves and displays DeepSeek account balance data, refreshes it periodically, and provides navigation to the official top-up page.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏显示账户余额与相关额度信息，并提供定时刷新和官方充值页面入口。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance information in the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with periodic refresh and access to the official top-up page.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek account balance through the official /user/balance API
Displays balance and usage-related values in a sidebar panel
Refreshes balance data automatically and manually
Opens the official DeepSeek top-up page and displays its URL as a QR code
Reads the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY through the host credential service
